The Panel Line Border Bed is an upholstered bed frame with a tall 54-inch padded panel headboard finished with a decorative border trim, handmade to order by our family-run team in our Dewsbury workshop. It suits a bedroom where you want the headboard to be the main feature, on a solid slatted base with no built-in storage. Sizes: Single 3ft £285.99, Small Double 4ft £318.99, Double 4ft6 £337.99, King 5ft £363.99 and Super King 6ft £415.99. Delivery is free across Great Britain to your door by our own team. Order free fabric swatches to choose your colour at home.

Good to know

  • Free delivery across Great Britain to your door (downstairs) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man: £90.
  • Room of Choice Drop Off: +£29.99. We carry it to the room you choose. Choose it under Delivery Service on this page.
  • Room of Choice Assembly: +£69.99. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99. Downstairs drop off stays free.
  • 14-day free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.
  • 5-year frame warranty.
  • Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout, or pay by card or PayPal.
  • Free fabric swatches: Order free fabric swatches before you choose a colour. Using your own fabric? We accept it and will confirm the fabric quantity for your size.

Key features

  • Panel line design with decorative border trim
  • Tall 54 inch deeply padded headboard
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £285.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £318.99
  • Double 4ft6: £337.99
  • King 5ft: £363.99
  • Super King 6ft: £415.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Mattress compatibility

This is a bed frame with no built-in storage, on a slatted base that suits standard UK mattresses. Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99) or 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99).

Customisation

Fully customisable in fabric and colour: solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches are available.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) to your door (downstairs) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Compare with the plainer Panel Line Headboard Bed, browse all panel beds, or see more upholstered beds. Unsure of your room size? Read how to measure your bedroom.

FAQ

How tall is the Panel Line Border Bed headboard?

The headboard is a tall 54 inches and deeply padded.

What is the border detail?

A decorative border trim runs around the structured panel, giving a more finished look than a plain panel headboard.

Which sizes are available?

Single 3ft £285.99, Small Double 4ft £318.99, Double 4ft6 £337.99, King 5ft £363.99, Super King 6ft £415.99.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Will a 54-inch headboard fit my room?

Measure the wall the bed will sit against, including any window sill, radiator or shelf above where the headboard will go. Our guide on how to measure your bedroom walks you through it. For a lower headboard, see the Panel Line Headboard Bed (24 inches).

Will you carry it upstairs and build it?

Free delivery is to your door (downstairs) across Great Britain. Choose Room of Choice Drop Off (+£29.99) and our team will carry it to the room you want. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99. Both are picked under Delivery Service on this page.

Can I use my own fabric?

Yes, we accept customer-supplied fabric. Call or email us first and we will confirm the fabric quantity for your size.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Panelled Storage Bed has a tall vertical-panel headboard on a divan base, shown in cream upholstery as standard. A drawer built into the base gives extra bedroom storage.

Key features

  • Tall vertical panel headboard
  • Divan base with built-in pull-out storage drawer
  • Sturdy solid frame construction
  • Handmade to order in West Yorkshire, UK

Sizes

Available in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a sturdy wooden frame. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke fabric, colour and size requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Delivery & assembly

Delivery across Great Britain is free and made by our own team, usually within 3 to 5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Want it built for you? Add room-of-choice assembly for £69.99 when you order.

Warranty & payment

Every bed comes with a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay. Questions? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

FAQ

How is this different from the Modern Panel Storage Bed?

This design has a tall vertical panel headboard. The Modern Panel Storage Bed is a more understated option that fits most bedroom styles.

What sizes does the Panelled Storage Bed with Drawer come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I order a different colour or fabric?

Yes. It comes in a wide range of colours in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free swatches can be sent.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3 to 5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.

Browse our full range of handmade storage beds for more headboard styles.
